## Summary

Describe what changed and why. If this closes an issue, add `Closes #N` so it auto-closes on merge to `trunk`.

## Verification

Run the gates in [docs/CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/thomasfosterau/effect-connect/blob/trunk/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md#before-pushing) and list each command with its final pass/fail. Say which gate couldn't run, and why.

## Changeset

- [ ] A changeset under `.changeset/` for every change to a published package's behaviour (or: none needed, because …)

## Notes

Anything reviewers should pay special attention to: exported signatures, declaration-emit shape, peer ranges.
